entries.description: Hunt is a high-level D Programming Language Web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It lets you build high-performance Web applications quickly and easily.

entries.name: grpc
entries.description: Grpc for D programming language, hunt-http library based.

entries.name: kissrpc
entries.description: Fast and light, flatbuffers based rpc framework.

entries.name: hunt-gossip
entries.description: A Apache V2 gossip protocol implementation for D programming language.

entries.name: hunt-cache
entries.description: D language universal cache library, using radix, redis and memcached.

entries.name: flatbuffers
entries.description: D Programming Language implementation of the google flatbuffers library.

entries.name: hunt-entity
entries.description: Hunt entity is an object-relational mapping tool for the D programming language. Referring to the design idea of JPA, support PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQLite.

entries.name: hunt-database
entries.description: Hunt database abstraction layer for D programing language, support PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQLite.

entries.name: hunt-console
entries.description: Hunt console creation easier to create powerful command-line applications.

entries.name: DWT
entries.description: A library for creating cross-platform GUI applications. GWT is a port of the Java SWT library to D. DWT was promoted as a semi-standard GUI library for D, but unfortunately didn't catch up popularity yet.

entries.name: LibUI
entries.description: Dynamic Binding for libui
